summary: Possible Baileys fork/lookalike with no traced harm
details: Package name `amanexzyra-baileys` resembles the popular WhatsApp Web API library `@whiskeysockets/baileys` family, which has been a frequent target of forks and lookalike publications. No exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent-relay, credential harvesting, or backdoor was observed in the package contents at version 4.0.2. Name similarity alone is a subjective signal and prior Baileys forks have included covert behavior using the installer's WhatsApp session identity (e.g., auto-subscribing the consumer to attacker-controlled channels); a human reviewer should confirm whether this fork introduces any undocumented side-effects against the installer's authenticated session before recommending its use.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
